criteria.requirement: Extend Section.merge(indict, *, comments="incoming") so Section inputs retain raw interpolations, key/section comments and inline comments while cloning incoming data and rebinding newly inserted sections to the target main/parent/depth. Default incoming metadata wins; comments="existing" retains metadata of preexisting names; repeated merges do not accumulate duplicate comments. Plain dict inputs have no comment metadata and preserve existing comments. Keep recursive value overwrite behavior, reject invalid policies and never mutate or attach source Section objects.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
